name: Negative funding with spot accumulation
hypothesis: Buy a qualified perpetual when negative funding and independent spot accumulation are followed by a spot range break.
spec: Setup: Bearish derivative positioning can coexist with strengthening spot demand. Entry: Buy a qualified perpetual when negative funding and independent spot accumulation are followed by a spot range break. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on spot failure or a registered funding/holding cutoff. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs open-interest, funding and liquidation history at intraday resolution (not connected)
